sentences.en: Depression is common among young adults who have Asperger syndrome.
sentences.zh: 患有阿斯伯格综合征的年轻人中抑郁症很常见。

sentences.en: In Brazil the prevalence of Asperger's Syndrome may reach 0.5%.
sentences.zh: 在巴西，阿斯伯格综合征的发病率可能达到0.5%。

sentences.en: All of her children were born with Down syndrome.
sentences.zh: 她的所有孩子出生时都患有唐氏综合症。

senses.zh: 综合征 - (某种条件下有共同特征的)一系列表现(事件、举动等) 形容词: syndromic
